note: Spec §17. Each rule carries jurisdiction, effective date, classification, an authoritative source and a last_reviewed date. A rule past review is reported as stale rather than applied silently. `code_signal` is the pattern whose ABSENCE raises a low-confidence finding — it is evidence of an unimplemented rule, never proof of non-compliance.

rules.title: Mandatory invoice mentions are not visibly validated
rules.requirement: A Belgian VAT invoice must carry the supplier and customer identification, the supplier VAT number, a sequential number, the invoice date, the supply date, the taxable base per rate, the rate, the VAT amount and any exemption reference.
rules.impact: An invoice missing a mandatory mention can be rejected by the customer's accountant and can put the customer's own deduction at risk. The product's name is on the document.
rules.recommendation: Validate the mandatory set at issue time and refuse to finalize a document that is missing one.
rules.verification_test: Issue an invoice with the VAT number removed; expect refusal.

rules.title: No gapless sequential numbering mechanism is visible
rules.requirement: Invoices must carry a sequential number drawn from one or more continuous series, assigned when the invoice is issued.
rules.impact: A gap or a reused number in an issued series is a defect that cannot be corrected retroactively without an explanation to the administration.
rules.recommendation: Allocate the number inside the issuing transaction, from a per-series counter held in the database.
rules.verification_test: Issue invoices concurrently and assert a contiguous series with no duplicates.

rules.title: Credit notes do not visibly reference the corrected invoice
rules.requirement: A corrective document must reference the document it corrects.
rules.impact: Spec §5.2: a credit note is a corrective financial document, not a way to edit an issued invoice. Without the link, the correction chain cannot be reconstructed.
rules.recommendation: Make the reference to the original invoice a required field on the credit note.
rules.verification_test: Attempt to create a credit note with no original invoice; expect refusal.

rules.title: No VAT identification number validation is visible
rules.requirement: A Belgian VAT number is BE followed by ten digits, the first of which is 0 or 1, with a modulo-97 check on the first eight digits. Intra-community treatment depends on the counterparty's number being valid.
rules.impact: Reverse-charge treatment applied against an invalid counterparty number leaves the supplier liable for the VAT.
rules.recommendation: Validate the format and checksum locally, and confirm against VIES before applying an intra-community exemption.
rules.verification_test: Enter a number failing the modulo-97 check; expect rejection.

rules.title: No retention period is enforced or documented for issued documents
rules.requirement: Books and invoices must be retained for ten years from 1 January of the year following their date.
rules.impact: A deletion routine that removes issued invoices before the retention period expires destroys records the company is required to hold — and a GDPR erasure request is not a lawful reason to delete them.
rules.recommendation: Encode the retention period, and make erasure of personal data distinct from deletion of statutory records.
rules.verification_test: Run an erasure request against a customer with issued invoices; assert the invoices survive and are pseudonymised only where lawful.
